svg.text: Flywheel next — capture: adapters run wherever the source is, every one writes the same keyed record, one session reads it, and the endpoint is one host among several
sources · adapters as packages on their hosts · captures, the raw store, triage, signals, moves · identities, secrets and how a source is added
no judgment · they supply raw material (§2, 115)
a chat forward · one word on the phone
switchboard · gvc · flywheel-cloud · a request opened by hand (178)
ADAPTERS · every one enumerates events and writes captures: arithmetic, unattended (115)
runs while the laptop is awake
key: the meeting id · raw: the transcript
key: the file's hash · raw: the file
writes straight to the blueprints' shared line through its own host binary · never through dispatch
any host with the App's installation on that repository
key: the comment id · raw: the thread
key: the issue event id · raw: the issue
reads the conversation with a scoped installation token · nothing in a request changes an intent except through curation
the capture endpoint · one adapter host among several
for callers that cannot write git · a job of dispatch, wherever dispatch is placed
no model · one request, one commit · the same key writes nothing · a forwarded message gets its one signal here, no reader
the host that serves the page
text sent unparsed to the capture tool
one signal of kind ask, so curation sees it
RECORDS · what every adapter writes, what one session reads, what curation moves
source · time · who · a pointer to raw
by curation, never by an adapter
an unmoved signal is never discarded (118)
an intent, opened by the operator
the one operator gesture · a control on the page,
never a word parsed out of the text · 19 · 22 · 193
triage · one bounded session per capture
reads the capture and its raw material, writes the signals once
judgment, never unattended · charged by the dispatcher's tick or the source's declared host
runs off the shared line · at most triage.bound at once · 113 · 115 · model §3–4
THE RAW STORE · outside every repository
transcripts · logs · exports · the drawer conversation
every capture points here and none contains it · named per source in the manifest
copy then capture: the reader runs wherever the store reaches
capture where it lies: the holding machine declares it triages that source
an unreachable pointer is a decision, not a stalled session · 111 · 118 · 149
curation · a charged session, not dispatch
clusters unmoved signals against claims and gives each signal its one move
never opens an intent · a person writing the same records is curation · 107 · 108 · 110 · 116
SECURITY · every identity and secret named in the manifest, placed by the operator, never by an agent
the endpoint · an inbound secret per caller
switchboard · Datadog · the bot · placed on both sides by the operator
never one shared secret · never in a capture or a signal
two identities · the App and the bot
the App's short-lived installation token, scoped to one repository, issued into a place
the bot's own account in the org's channel · never the operator's · never a personal token
the tool server's identity check · MCP callers
every tool call carries the session's identity, issued when the machinery started it
a call whose identity is not the pane it came from is refused
the machinery writes state and the thread; dispatch reads · a session speaks only through the tools
a missing secret is a decision under attention, never a value an agent supplies
the App's private key · the bot token · model keys · the network node key · each caller's inbound secret — in the org's sealed store, no record cites them (dispatch captures §3, what dispatch needs)
EXTENSION · adding a source = installing an adapter package
offered on the setup surface · the operator names the host it runs on · its secret or token is placed under attention (149)
every package is one enumerator: a source, an event key, a raw pointer, a host to run on — the same capture record whoever wrote it
any tool that writes the record is an adapter · captures made before the flywheel existed are read without conversion · the formats are versioned and stable
a webhook caller's package installs at the endpoint; an edge package on the laptop; a repository package on a host with the App's installation there
the package tag, the setup surface and the shipped-or-marketplace split are this diagram's proposal; no requirement names them yet
an adapter's write · one capture per event

capture is decentralized: any adapter, any machine, one record per event, keyed so twice is once (111, 114) · triage is one session per capture, charged where the raw material can be read (115) · the endpoint is one host among several, never where capture lives
